newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields mainly lower on latest Saudi t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields mainly lower on latest Saudi t-bills.

text.p: Yields were mainly lower at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the yield on 28-day bills fell to 5.7384 percent from 5.8523 a week earlier, and the rate on 91-day paper dropped to 5.7936 percent from 5.8811 percent last week.
The yield on 182-day bills climbed to 6.0156 from 5.9535 percent, while the rate on 364-day paper declined to 6.0338 percent from 6.1121 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.55566, 98.55664, 97.04853 and 94.25000 respectively.
One-month deposit rates were quoted at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, three months at six, 5-7/8 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one year at 6-3/16, 1/16 percent.
